args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on the PHL label confusion.

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so the two can collide in searches and reports.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's coverage check (18 May) flagged a saved report that still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The label change is on the handoff list, but the old name is still there.
- Ask: rename the saved report to Pellow Home Living so supervisors stop searching under two names.

Thanks,
Sofia and Bettina
